title: No tap water 6 am Tue to 6 pm Wed in Nampally, Mallepally, Banjara Hills
body: HMWSSB is plugging major leaks in the Gandipet conduit near Sabza Colony, Tolichowki and Manikonda. Supply stops for 36 hours from 6 am Nov 3 to 6 pm Nov 4 in parts of Golconda zone, Kavadiguda and Banjara Hills.
means: Store two days of drinking water by Monday night
Areas: Red Hills, Nampally, Mallepally, Asif Nagar, Domalguda, Banjara Hills ward and more
HMWSSB asks everyone to use water sparingly
care: Fill tanks and store water by Monday night.
